payload.summary: Ward mockups end-to-end suite: 15 assertion failures on its first full run, one referral column clipped at 641px, and the suite is selected by neither verify:ui path
payload.detail: FIRST FULL RUN OF THE chromium-mockups PROJECT. 2026-09-10 at 8b4b96fa9c, dev server, workers=1, 10.9 minutes. RECONCILED: 171 declared, 171 run - 151 passed + 15 failed + 5 skipped. Playwright exit 1. The harness reported 'completed (exit code 0)' for the same run because the command ended in echo; read the recorded exit= line, never the notice. ALL 15 ARE ASSERTION FAILURES - toHaveURL, toHaveCount, toBeVisible, toEqual, element(s) not found. ZERO browser-loss or timeout. That is materially different from the previously recorded state (2026-09-06: 78 tests, 1 failure that WAS a browser lost under memory pressure), so that old note does not describe this run and must not be used to explain it away. THREE ARE WARD. (a) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:1056 - ONE column of the queued referral table is clipped by about 17px at a 641px viewport, reachable only by scrolling sideways inside the table. The guard's own words: 'Home region (right edge 623 vs scroller 606)'. *** CORRECTION 2026-09-10, SECOND RETRACTION ON THIS ROW: the two requests before this one said the guard 'permits one such entry and found four'. BOTH HALVES ARE FALSE. The assertion is .toEqual([]) at spec line 1096 - it permits ZERO. And the received array holds TWO entries, not four: '- Expected - 1 / + Received + 4' are counts of DIFF LINES, not of columns. The two entries are not two columns either - the guard collects thead th together with tbody tr:first-child td (spec line 1071), so 'Home region' is the column heading and 'Perth Metropolitan' is the first data cell beneath it, identical geometry, ONE column reported twice. *** *** SCOPE, NARROWER THAN PREVIOUSLY RECORDED: the test walks widths 641, 700, 760 and 820 and expect throws at the first failure. It failed at 641, so 700, 760 and 820 WERE NEVER MEASURED. Nothing is known about them in either direction. *** *** EARLIER RETRACTION, RETAINED SO IT CANNOT BE RE-ASSERTED: the first version of this row claimed the overflow was 'the predictable consequence of an APPROVED change', citing owner-ruling-2026-09-07-board-columns.md and its five new columns. THAT WAS FALSE AND UNCHECKED. Presentation, Review status, Plan, Bed number and Legal form expiry do not exist anywhere in src/components/ward-management/ and belong to the ward BOARD, a different screen; this table's columns are Referral, Tier, Since referral, Age band, Sex, Home region. On that invented cause the finding was escalated to the owner twice as a decision only he could make. It is not. *** (b) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:414 - 'fixture assumption: the seed's queued referrals, in the queue's own order'. The test's hard-coded list holds 4 ids and the app produced 6; the two extra are RF-015 and RF-014. (An earlier version of this row wrote that as 'expected 0 received 2', which are diff line counts, not list lengths.) Which side is right - the fixture or the seed - is UNCHECKED. (c) ui-ward-roles.spec.ts:559 - getByTestId('ward-ed-inbox-empty') not found for peel-ed; the handle IS declared and renderable at ed-screen.tsx:1305, so this is a STATE question, not a dead handle. ed-screen.tsx and ward-referrals.ts are claimed on the register by Ward Builder One, whose in-flight work splits ED-addressed referrals into expects versus in-department - named as a hypothesis with evidence, NOT a diagnosis; nobody has read that change. TWELVE ARE OUTSIDE WARD FLOW and belong to their own programmes, not to Ward Flow: ui-caring-contact-mockup (4), ui-tools-collapse (3), ui-tools-task-directory (2), ui-sidebar-live-mockup (2), ui-answer-chat-perfected-mockup (1). Owner stated 2026-09-10 that Caring Contacts is not part of this project; those four are recorded here only so the measurement stays whole, and Ward Flow is not routing them. SCOPE: ONE run - no claim about stability in either direction, and policy needs three reproductions on one SHA before quarantine. Because test:e2e:pr takes --project=chromium plus the seeded project and grep-inverts @mockup, these failures may be weeks old; NOTHING HERE ASSERTS A RECENT REGRESSION. NEXT ACTION: owner deferred routing 2026-09-10.
